WITH
  -- Test Main
  -- /ui/proj/data-marts/main-1/data-setup
  main AS (
    SELECT
      customer_id,
      id,
      status
    FROM [Orders](dm:ord1)
  ),

  -- Test Subsidiary
  -- /ui/proj/data-marts/sub-1/data-setup
  customers_raw AS (
    SELECT
      city,
      id
    FROM [Customers](dm:cus1)
  ),

  customers AS (
    SELECT
      id,
      STRING_AGG(CAST(city AS STRING), ', ' ORDER BY CAST(city AS STRING)) AS customers__city
    FROM customers_raw
    GROUP BY id
  ),

  -- Test Subsidiary
  -- /ui/proj/data-marts/sub-1/data-setup
  order_items_raw AS (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      sku
    FROM [Order Items](dm:itm1)
  ),

  order_items AS (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      STRING_AGG(CAST(sku AS STRING), ', ' ORDER BY CAST(sku AS STRING)) AS order_items__sku
    FROM order_items_raw
    GROUP BY order_id
  )

SELECT
  main.id,
  main.status,
  customers.customers__city,
  order_items.order_items__sku
FROM main
LEFT JOIN customers ON main.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN order_items ON main.id = order_items.order_id
WHERE customers.customers__city = 'Paris'
  AND (order_items.order_items__sku IS NULL OR TRIM(order_items.order_items__sku) = '')
  AND (customers.customers__city IS NULL OR customers.customers__city <> 'Rome')
  AND (customers.customers__city IS NULL OR STRPOS(customers.customers__city, 'ar') = 0)

  SUM(main.amount) AS "amount | SUM",
  COUNT(customers.customers__n) AS "customers__n | COUNT"
FROM main
LEFT JOIN customers ON main.customer_id = customers.id
GROUP BY
  main.status
HAVING SUM(main.amount) > 100
  AND COUNT(customers.customers__n) <= 5

WITH
  -- Test Main
  -- /ui/proj/data-marts/main-1/data-setup
  main AS (
    SELECT
      amount,
      customer_id,
      status
    FROM [Orders](dm:ord1)
  ),

  -- Test Subsidiary
  -- /ui/proj/data-marts/sub-1/data-setup
  customers_raw AS (
    SELECT
      id,
      n
    FROM [Customers](dm:cus1)
  ),

  customers AS (
    SELECT
      id,
      COUNT(n) AS customers__n
    FROM customers_raw
    GROUP BY id
  )

SELECT
  `status`,
  SUM(`amount`) AS `amount | SUM`,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(`amount`, 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS `amount | MEDIAN`,
  DATE_TRUNC(DATE(`created_at`, 'Europe/Berlin'), MONTH) AS `created_at`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT `name`) AS `name | COUNTUNIQUE`,
  STRING_AGG(CAST(`name` AS STRING), ', ') AS `name | STRINGAGG`
FROM [Orders](dm:ord1) AS src
WHERE src.`status` = 'paid'
GROUP BY
  `status`,
  DATE_TRUNC(DATE(`created_at`, 'Europe/Berlin'), MONTH)
ORDER BY
  `amount | SUM` DESC
